title: About Us
body:
Northline started in 1998 as a two-person pump repair shop in Spokane. Today we are a team of 34: sales engineers, workshop technicians and field service crews.

Our workshop

Every pump and valve we refurbish goes through the same bench tests as a new one.

title: Services
body:
Repair and refurbishment

Pumps, compressors and valves of any brand, with a written test report.

Rentals

Dewatering pumps and diesel compressors by the day, week or month.

Maintenance contracts

Planned visits, oil analysis and priority call-outs.

Energy audits

Compressed-air and pumping system audits with measured savings.
